description: List, create, update or delete composite fonts (Type > Composite Fonts), mojikumi sets with detailed aki overrides per character class (Type > Mojikumi Settings) and kinsoku sets (Type > Kinsoku Shori Settings) in the active document. Apply them to text with set_character_attributes

akiOverrides.description: Mojikumi detailed settings: aki between character classes (yakumono classes), each { targetClass, sideClass, sideIsAfterTarget, minimum, desired, maximum, compressionPriority, akiDoesNotFloat }; replaces the existing overrides

basedOn.description: Mojikumi: the MojikumiTableDefaults set a new set starts from, e.g. LINE_END_ALL_ONE_HALF_EM_ENUM

cantBeSeparatedChars.description: Kinsoku: characters that cannot be separated

cantBeginLineChars.description: Kinsoku: characters that cannot begin a line

cantEndLineChars.description: Kinsoku: characters that cannot end a line

entries.description: Composite font entries to set: name (Kanji, Kana, Full-width Punctuation, Full-width Symbols, Half-width Roman, Half-width Numerals, or a custom set), fontName ("Family\tStyle" or family), relativeSize, baselineShift, horizontalScale, verticalScale (percents and points), scaleOption, customCharacters (for a new custom set)

name.description: The set or composite font name (not needed for list)

name: manage_cjk_sets
title: Manage Cjk Sets
